database_saturated_comparisons.unavailable: both paths must independently demonstrate sustained database CPU saturation and a verified next-level throughput plateau; increase concurrency or isolate client/Weir resources; I/O/network-bound saturation needs additional device/link capacity evidence

method: independent OS client processes send one record per native call or unary SDK RPC; native FindOne/ReplaceOne or single-ID mget/PUT; no client aggregation; worker-owned disjoint IDs; common phase barriers and unchanged pools across warmup and measurement; alternating AB/BA; latency is each business request including validation, queueing and any server aggregation; independent persisted postflight; sustained database CPU requires >=5 intervals, >=80% measurement coverage, mean CPU>=threshold and CPU>=threshold during >=80% measurement duration in every round, plus <=10% next-level throughput gain
